title: Update-submodules dependency command is invalid as a YAML plain scalar
protocol: GitHub Actions workflow YAML and Update submodules read-only validation
observed_behavior: Draft Parent PR #92 initial head f22e3fdb322e93cf9b37e13ede13007c912e0f9b caused five shared structure/quick-check jobs to fail before candidate validation. The Framework workflow-YAML checker reports .github/workflows/update-submodules.yml invalid YAML because the unquoted run scalar contains --only-binary=:all: followed by whitespace.
expected_behavior: The Pip command is a valid YAML scalar while preserving the exact --require-hashes and --only-binary=:all: command, its read-only validator placement, and the isolated publisher boundary.
impact: The initial corrective PR head could not reach exact-head verification because repository structure/quick-check jobs failed at shared workflow parsing. The quoted correction is now validated on PR #92 exact head 40a419d5b0f599566469060112b7e55dbab05744; the remaining master-only validation requires a separate user-authorized merge and workflow rerun.
preconditions: Draft Parent PR #92 at initial head f22e3fdb322e93cf9b37e13ede13007c912e0f9b
Framework workflow-YAML validation is run by the structure/lint jobs
The workflow contains the initial unquoted --only-binary=:all: run scalar
reproduction: Parse .github/workflows/update-submodules.yml with PyYAML or run the Framework workflow-YAML checker.
Observe yaml.scanner.ScannerError mapping values are not allowed at the colon following :all:.
Observe shared hosted jobs fail before candidate validation and publisher execution.

evidence.command: gh run view 29984445209 --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-conector --log-failed; PyYAML safe_load of .github/workflows/update-submodules.yml
gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-conector/commits/40a419d5b0f599566469060112b7e55dbab05744/check-runs --paginate; gh pr view 92 --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-conector --json comments

root_cause: The initial remediation placed a command containing :all: in an unquoted YAML plain scalar. The closing colon is followed by whitespace, which violates YAML plain-scalar parsing rules and prevents the workflow from loading.
proposed_remediation: Completed on Draft Parent PR #92: double-quote the complete run command and extend the static workflow-security test to require the quoted run scalar. Parsing, focused CI-security and bilingual checks, and the fresh exact-head PR cycle passed while preserving package-integrity flags and validation/publisher permissions. Keep the finding fixed until a separately authorized merge and master-only rerun supply final verification.
acceptance_criteria: The update-submodules workflow parses successfully with PyYAML.
The dependency command remains exact, hash-required, binary-only, and positioned between the interpreter contract and make quick-check.
The static CI-security test rejects removal of the YAML quotes for this scalar.
Focused local validation and make check-ci-security-contract pass without changing permissions, secrets, publisher behavior, Framework, MRTS, or gitlink.

PR #92 exact-head checks replaced the initial YAML parser failures: final head 40a419d5b0f599566469060112b7e55dbab05744 has 33 successful and 6 expected-skipped terminal checks, with a passed SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate.
validation_plan: Parse the workflow with PyYAML after quoting the scalar.
Run the focused update-submodules workflow-security test and make check-ci-security-contract.
Run focused bilingual documentation tests and git diff --check.
Run a focused CI supply-chain security-diff review for the amended exact source state.
Push the task-owned amendment and inspect a fresh PR #92 exact-head GitHub Actions and SonarQube Cloud cycle.
After separately authorized integration, rerun the master-only workflow before changing this fixed finding to verified.
legitimate_control_tests: Validator retains contents: read and has no GH_TOKEN or secrets reference.
Publisher remains separately gated on successful validation and revalidates the full official SHA.
The CI-only PyYAML lock remains exact and hash-locked after YAML quoting.
dependencies: Separately authorized future master integration and master-only rerun for final FND-PARENT-0049/FND-PARENT-0048/FND-PARENT-0045 verification
residual_risk: The YAML parser regression is fixed and exact-head PR checks passed, but a separately authorized merge and master-only rerun are still required for verified status. Until then automated Framework candidate publication remains unproven; the existing fail-closed validation and isolated writer prevent publication on failure. No risk is accepted.
